title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, my friend Anna and I took a train to the mountains. The journey was long, but the views from the window were beautiful. We stayed in a small wooden hotel near a lake.

On the second day, we walked to the top of a hill. It was cold and windy, so we wore warm jackets. In the evening, we ate soup in a restaurant and talked about our plans.

questions.text: How did Anna and the narrator travel to the mountains?
What did they wear when they walked to the top of the hill?
Why did the friends wear warm jackets on the second day?
options: Because the weather was cold and windy
Because they wanted to swim in the lake
Because the hotel was too hot

questions.text: How did the friends probably feel about their trip?
options: They wanted to go home at once

vocabulary.definition: a trip from one place to another

paragraph_translations: Latem zeszłego roku moja przyjaciółka Anna i ja wybraliśmy się pociągiem w góry. Podróż była długa, ale widoki z okna były piękne. Zatrzymaliśmy się w małym drewnianym hotelu w pobliżu jeziora.
Drugiego dnia wspięliśmy się na szczyt wzgórza. Było zimno i wietrznie, więc założyliśmy ciepłe kurtki. Wieczorem zjedliśmy zupę w restauracji i rozmawialiśmy o naszych planach.
